description: This file defines the EmpPictureDecorator class, which provides a decorator for the EmpPicture entity, enabling additional functionality such as retrieving the employee's picture as a string, setting employee references by employee number, and utilizing traits for ORM helpers.

classes.name: EmpPictureDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpPicture entity, providing methods to access and manipulate employee picture data, including handling picture resources and setting employee reference by employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes EmpPictureDecorator with an EmpPicture entity.

methods.name: getEmpPicture
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the wrapped EmpPicture entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity associated with the picture based on employee number.

methods.name: getPicture
methods.description: Returns the picture as a string, converting resource streams if necessary.
